title: H2A.Z facilitates Sox2-nucleosome interaction by promoting DNA and histone H3 tail mobility.
authors: Moos, Helen K; Patel, Rutika; Flaherty, Sophie K; Loverde, Sharon M; Nikolova, Evgenia N
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文结合MD模拟与NMR研究H2A.Z核小体如何通过增强DNA和H3尾动态促进先锋因子Sox2结合，聚焦核小体-转录因子互作机制，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合建模。
abstract: Epigenetic regulation of eukaryotic chromatin structure and function can be modulated by histone variants and post-translational modifications. The conserved variant H2A.Z has been functionally linked to pioneer factors Sox2 and Oct4 that open chromatin and initiate cell fate-specific expression programs. However, the molecular basis for their interaction remains unknown. Using biochemistry, nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, we examine the role of H2A.Z nucleosome dynamics in pioneer factor binding. We find that H2A.Z facilitates Sox2 and Oct4 binding at distinct locations in 601 nucleosomes. We further link this to increased DNA accessibility and perturbed dynamics of the H3 N-terminal tail, which we show competes with Sox2 for DNA binding. Our simulations validate a coupling between H2A.Z-mediated DNA unwrapping and altered H3 N-tail conformations with fewer contacts to DNA and the H2A.Z C- terminal tail. This destabilizing effect of H2A.Z is DNA sequence dependent and enhanced with the less stable Lin28B nucleosome. Collectively, our findings suggest that H2A.Z promotes pioneer factor binding by increasing access to DNA and reducing competition with H3 tails. This could have broader implications for how epigenetic marks or oncogenic mutations tune pioneer factor engagement with chromatin and thus affect its structure and recognition.
abstract_zh: 真核染色质结构与功能的表观遗传调控可通过组蛋白变体及翻译后修饰进行调节。保守变体H2A.Z在功能上与先驱因子Sox2和Oct4相关联，这些因子可打开染色质并启动细胞命运特异性表达程序。然而，它们相互作用的分子基础仍属未知。利用生物化学、核磁共振（NMR）波谱学和分子动力学（MD）模拟，我们研究了H2A.Z核小体动力学在先驱因子结合中的作用。我们发现H2A.Z促进了Sox2和Oct4在601核小体中不同位置的结合。我们进一步将此与DNA可及性增加及H3 N端尾部动力学扰动联系起来，并证明后者与Sox2竞争DNA结合。我们的模拟验证了H2A.Z介导的DNA解旋与H3 N端尾部构象改变之间的耦合，该构象改变导致与DNA及H2A.Z C端尾部的接触减少。H2A.Z的这种去稳定效应具有DNA序列依赖性，并在稳定性较差的Lin28B核小体中增强。总体而言，我们的发现表明H2A.Z通过增加DNA可及性并减少与H3尾部的竞争来促进先驱因子结合。这可能对表观遗传标记或致癌突变如何调节先驱因子与染色质的结合，从而影响其结构和识别，具有更广泛的意义。
